name: Ranger Xenoseeker
body:
Some rangers specialize in going into unfamiliar areas where they are unlikely to have ever experienced the kind of creatures they will be battling.

Monster Lore (Ex)

You add your Wisdom modifier on Knowledge skill checks in addition to your Intelligence modifier, when making skill checks to identify the abilities and weaknesses of creatures. This feature replaces wild empathy.

Selective Enemy (Ex)

At 1st level, when you successfully identify a creature you can see with a Knowledge check, you can designate that creature your favored enemy as a swift action. For the next 24 hours, you gain a +2 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against your target and all creatures of the same species. Likewise, you get a +2 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against your target and creatures of the same species as your target.

You can use this ability once at 1st level. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, you gain one additional use per day of this ability, to a maximum of 5 times per day at 20th level. In addition, at each of these levels, your bonus against your favored enemy increases by 1, to a maximum of +6 at 20th level. This feature alters favored enemy.

Selective Terrain (Ex)

At 3rd level, whenever you spend at least 10 minutes in a given type of terrain, you can designate it as your favored terrain. For the next 24 hours, you gain a +1 bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks when you are in this terrain. When traveling through your favored terrain, you normally leave no trail and cannot be tracked (though you may leave a trail if you so choose).

You can use this ability once per day at 3rd level. At 8th level and every five levels thereafter, you can use this ability one additional time per day, to a maximum of 4 times per day at 18th level. In addition, your bonus increases by 1 at each of these levels, to a maximum of +4 at 18th level.

If a specific terrain falls into more than one category of favored terrain, your bonuses do not stack; you simply use whichever bonus is higher. This feature alters favored terrain.
